about: Head coaches whose game notes print no record by opponent, with the teams they have coached and when. The record by opponent is counted from our results (2016-17 on) and used only when it adds up to the career record the notes print. Only coaches whose whole head-coaching career is since 2016-17 can be listed.

Tiago Splitter.source: Bulls game notes for 11/16/26 (2025-26 Trail Blazers 42-39, 2026-27 Bulls); our results: Portland was 42-39 after its first game of 2025-26
